HOW THIS WORKS

Know what has been checked.

The curated collection

These listings were researched using organizer, university and government sources. Each shows its own last-reviewed date. An exact deadline can be confirmed while another detail remains uncertain. An anticipated month is never presented as a confirmed day.

Automatic source updates

The Latest updates page collects public announcements from StudyQA, No Borders Abroad, Scholars4Dev and Opportunity Desk. These sources are checked automatically on Monday mornings in Hong Kong time. The updater runs independently on the hosting service.

Incoming posts are discovery leads. Their eligibility, funding and deadlines have not been independently checked. The source status and last successful collection time are shown. If a source is unavailable, previously saved announcements can remain visible with a warning.

Eligibility and funding

Always check the linked provider’s requirements. Nationality, residency, age, qualifications, school nomination and degree choice can affect eligibility. A tuition waiver does not necessarily pay for living costs, travel or admission fees.

Dates and your shortlist

Known final deadlines hide closed opportunities from the main list. You can still see them through the filter and in your shortlist. Your tracker, stages and notes are stored only in this browser. Export a backup before clearing browser data, and restore it to move your tracker to another device. Share links and calendar files exclude your notes. Calendar exports are all-day date reminders, not exact cut-offs or guaranteed alerts. This website does not submit applications or send messages on your behalf.
